<span id="L134" class="source-line"><a href="#L134" class="line-number" data-line="134" aria-label="Line 134" tabindex="-1"></a>                    &#125;)),</span>
<span id="L135" class="source-line"><a href="#L135" class="line-number" data-line="135" aria-label="Line 135" tabindex="-1"></a>            )</span>
<span id="L136" class="source-line"><a href="#L136" class="line-number" data-line="136" aria-label="Line 136" tabindex="-1"></a>    &#125;</span>
<span id="L137" class="source-line"><a href="#L137" class="line-number" data-line="137" aria-label="Line 137" tabindex="-1"></a>&#125;</span>
<span id="L138" class="source-line"><a href="#L138" class="line-number" data-line="138" aria-label="Line 138" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="L139" class="source-line"><a href="#L139" class="line-number" data-line="139" aria-label="Line 139" tabindex="-1"></a>// ## Start from an idle view &#123;#launch&#125;</span>
<span id="L140" class="source-line"><a href="#L140" class="line-number" data-line="140" aria-label="Line 140" tabindex="-1"></a>// [`AppContext::new`] creates the view with no task, a Start button, and Ready</span>
<span id="L141" class="source-line"><a href="#L141" class="line-number" data-line="141" aria-label="Line 141" tabindex="-1"></a>// status. Press Start to create the view-owned task. Wait less than two seconds,</span>
<span id="L142" class="source-line"><a href="#L142" class="line-number" data-line="142" aria-label="Line 142" tabindex="-1"></a>// then press Stop: the status should remain Stopped after the original deadline.</span>
<span id="L143" class="source-line"><a href="#L143" class="line-number" data-line="143" aria-label="Line 143" tabindex="-1"></a>// Start again and let the operation finish to check the completion path too.</span>
<span id="L144" class="source-line"><a href="#L144" class="line-number" data-line="144" aria-label="Line 144" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="L145" class="source-line"><a href="#L145" class="line-number" data-line="145" aria-label="Line 145" tabindex="-1"></a>fn component(window: &amp;mut Window, cx: &amp;mut gpui::App) -&gt; gpui::Entity&lt;AsyncDemo&gt; &#123;</span>
<span id="L146" class="source-line"><a href="#L146" class="line-number" data-line="146" aria-label="Line 146" tabindex="-1"></a>    cx.new(|cx| &#123;</span>
<span id="L147" class="source-line"><a href="#L147" class="line-number" data-line="147" aria-label="Line 147" tabindex="-1"></a>        let focus = cx.focus_handle();</span>
<span id="L148" class="source-line"><a href="#L148" class="line-number" data-line="148" aria-label="Line 148" tabindex="-1"></a>        window.focus(&amp;focus, cx);</span>
<span id="L149" class="source-line"><a href="#L149" class="line-number" data-line="149" aria-label="Line 149" tabindex="-1"></a>        AsyncDemo &#123;</span>
<span id="L150" class="source-line"><a href="#L150" class="line-number" data-line="150" aria-label="Line 150" tabindex="-1"></a>            focus,</span>
<span id="L151" class="source-line"><a href="#L151" class="line-number" data-line="151" aria-label="Line 151" tabindex="-1"></a>            task: None,</span>
<span id="L152" class="source-line"><a href="#L152" class="line-number" data-line="152" aria-label="Line 152" tabindex="-1"></a>            running: false,</span>
<span id="L153" class="source-line"><a href="#L153" class="line-number" data-line="153" aria-label="Line 153" tabindex="-1"></a>            message: &quot;Ready&quot;.into(),</span>
<span id="L154" class="source-line"><a href="#L154" class="line-number" data-line="154" aria-label="Line 154" tabindex="-1"></a>        &#125;</span>
<span id="L155" class="source-line"><a href="#L155" class="line-number" data-line="155" aria-label="Line 155" tabindex="-1"></a>    &#125;)</span>
<span id="L156" class="source-line"><a href="#L156" class="line-number" data-line="156" aria-label="Line 156" tabindex="-1"></a>&#125;</span>
<span id="L157" class="source-line"><a href="#L157" class="line-number" data-line="157" aria-label="Line 157" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="L158" class="source-line"><a href="#L158" class="line-number" data-line="158" aria-label="Line 158" tabindex="-1"></a>pub fn main() &#123;</span>
<span id="L159" class="source-line"><a href="#L159" class="line-number" data-line="159" aria-label="Line 159" tabindex="-1"></a>    support::run(component);</span>
<span id="L160" class="source-line"><a href="#L160" class="line-number" data-line="160" aria-label="Line 160" tabindex="-1"></a>&#125;</span></code></pre>
